note: Only DCA-axis/ordination or unsigned composition associations with soil moisture / water table. Excluded e11/e22/e46/e62 ('water min'/'water dif' undefined in text), e60 (richness, not composition), e25 (climatic P-PE, not soil wetness).
No candidate concerns visitor trampling or recreation; disturbance treatments, winter road clearances and road use are not instances.
No logging/harvest edge with a soil compaction or structure outcome; e35 is forest-to-fallow conversion, e19 soil loading, e28 salvage logging -> pH (chemistry).
No built stream/shoreline structure edge with a mammal outcome; weir edges concern lake sturgeon habitat, e8 woody debris windrows are not stream structures.

Excluded vegetation 'suppression' (e1/e27/e55/e63) and 'neighbor control' (e35) since the method (cutting vs herbicide) is not stated; e34 compares clipping seasons only; e57 Shannon diversity counted as species-number class.

Treated 'passage of time' in the marine reserve study as time since protection; excluded lake trout edges e15/e45/e56 whose cause node is a calendar year ('Year 2011'), not time since disturbance. Including them would make direction mixed.
No temperature/warming edge with a predation, seed consumption or damage outcome.
Water table position treated as soil water content. Excluded e3 (soil anoxia, not moisture per se; would add an increase vote) and e4 (CH4 differences attributed to cottongrass).
Excluded experimental crayfish introduction (e1/e2/e6) as invasive-species addition rather than reintroduction/stocking; e3 outcome is diatoms, not invertebrates.
Scarification edges concern soil nutrients and temperature only; no erosion or sediment loss outcome.
